# Phenotype figures

This file creates figures of the various phenotype plots for the manuscript.

### Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(officer)
```

## Figure: Life-history phenotypes

Load ggplot files

```{r}
mass_plot <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/mass_plot.RDS")
fec_plot <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/fec_plot.RDS")
surv_plot <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/surv_plot.RDS")
```

Tweak existing plots as required

```{r}
mass_plot <- mass_plot + guides(color = 'none', shape = 'none') + 
  labs(x = NULL)

surv_plot <- surv_plot + guides(color = 'none', shape = 'none')

print(mass_plot)
print(surv_plot)
```

### Assemble life-history figure with patchwork

```{r}
lh_fig <- mass_plot/(surv_plot|fec_plot) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "Life-history consequences of selection for improved flight performance",
  tag_levels = 'A'
) & theme_cowplot() & theme(legend.position = 'right')
  
print(lh_fig)

#ggsave(lh_fig, filename = "../../Plots/LH_fig.jpeg", dpi = 400,
#      width = 12, height = 12)
```

## Load tables, p.adjust and publish tables

#### Load tables for phenotypic results

```{r}
# evolution of flight performance
fltevol_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/fltevol_tables.RDS")

# factorial flight performance experiment
factflt_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/factflt_tables.RDS")

# activity data
act_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/act_tables.RDS")

# dry mass tables
mass_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/mass_tables.RDS")

# survivorship tables
surv_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/surv_tables.RDS")

# fecundity tables
fec_tables <- readRDS("../../Tables/fec_tables.RDS")

```

### Tables: Evolution of flight performance

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(fltevol_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
flightevol_anames <- c("a_selgen", "a_CON", "a_FP")
flightevol_ANOVA <- mget(flightevol_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

flightevol_ANOVA <- flightevol_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Evol_Flight_Performance", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_selgen" ~ "Sel_Gen_fact",
    Model == "a_CON" ~ "CON_Gen",
    Model == "a_FP" ~ "FP_Gen"
  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
flightevol_enames <- c("e_selgen", "e_CON", "e_FP")
flightevol_etasq <- mget(flightevol_enames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

flightevol_etasq <- flightevol_etasq %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Evol_Flight_Performance", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "e_selgen" ~ "Sel_Gen_fact",
    Model == "e_CON" ~ "CON_Gen",
    Model == "e_FP" ~ "FP_Gen"
  ))

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
```

### Tables: Factorial flight performance

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(factflt_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
factflight_ANOVA <- a_fact_bestmod %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Additive_mod", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Factorial_Flight_Performance", .before = 1)

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
factflight_etasq <- e_fact_bestmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "Additive_mod", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Factorial_Flight_Performance", .before = 1)

# AIC table
factflight_AIC <- fact_aic
# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(fact_aic)
```

### Tables: Activity assay

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(act_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
activity_ANOVA <- a_actmod %>% 
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex+Assay", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Activity_assay", .before = 1)

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
activity_etasq <- e_actmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex+Assay", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Activity_assay", .before = 1)


# AIC table
activity_AIC <- act_aic

# Tukey table
activity_Tukey <- summary(tuk_actmod$contrasts)

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(act_aic)
rm(tuk_actmod)
```

### Tables: Dry mass

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(mass_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

mass_anames <- c("a_fit_sel_f", "a_fit_sel_m")
mass_ANOVA <- mget(mass_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

mass_ANOVA <- mass_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Dry_Mass", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_fit_sel_f" ~ "Sel_Females",

  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
mass_etasq <- e_fullmassmod %>%
  mutate(Model = "SelxSex", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Dry_Mass", .before = 1)

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
```

### Tables: Fecundity

```{r}
# unpack all variables within the list of tables
list2env(fec_tables, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Save the ANOVA tables into a dataframe
fecundity_anames <- c("a_fec", "a_logfec")
fecundity_ANOVA <- mget(fecundity_anames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

fecundity_ANOVA <- fecundity_ANOVA %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Fecundity", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "a_fec" ~ "percapita_Fecundity",
    Model == "a_logfec" ~ "log_percapita_Fecundity"
  ))

# Save effect size tables into a dataframe
fecundity_enames <- c("e_fec", "e_logfec")
fecundity_etasq <- mget(fecundity_enames) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Model")

fecundity_etasq <- fecundity_etasq %>% 
  mutate(Assay_name = "Fecundity", .before = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Model = case_when(
    Model == "e_fec" ~ "percapita_Fecundity",
    Model == "e_logfec" ~ "log_percapita_Fecundity"
  ))

# AIC table
fecundity_AIC <- logfec_aic

# correlation tables
# correlation of total female population size and total fecundity
# CON correlation
fecCON_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpopCON)) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: CON")
  
# FP correlation
fecFP_corr <- gt(tidy(corr_fecpopFP)) %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Correlation of female population size and total fecundity: FP")

# Remove all variables loaded from the list, to avoid cluttering of variable names
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^[a|e]_"))
rm(logfec_aic, corr_fecpopCON, corr_fecpopFP)
```

### Join ANOVA and eta-squared tables

```{r}
ANOVA_names <- ls(pattern = "_ANOVA")

Phenotypes_ANOVA <- ANOVA_names %>% mget(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Table_Name")

etasq_names <- ls(pattern = "_etasq")

Phenotypes_etasquared_df <- etasq_names %>% mget(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "Table_Name")

Phenotypes_etasquared <- Phenotypes_etasquared_df  %>% 
  datasummary_df(fmt = 3, output = 'gt') %>% 
  tab_header(title = "Partial eta-squared values for all phenotype assays")
```

## Figure: Flight performance

Load data

```{r}
m_flightgen <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/m_flightgen_plot.RDS")

fl_m_heat <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/flight_mheatplt.RDS")

rep_fl_heat <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/flight_repheatplt.RDS")

flight_fact_plot <- readRDS("../../Plots/ggplot_files/Fact_mdist_plot.RDS")
```

### Assemble flight performance plots with patchwork

```{r}
flight_fig <- m_flightgen/fl_m_heat/flight_fact_plot +
plot_annotation(
  title = "Evolution of flight performance",
  tag_levels = 'A'
) & theme_cowplot()

print(flight_fig)

ggsave(flight_fig, filename = "../../Plots/flight_fig.jpeg", 
       dpi = 400, width = 12, height = 12)
```
